Title: Azure SQL—General availability updates for mid-November 2021

Body.Content:
In mid-November 2021, the following updates and enhancements were made to Azure SQL: 

  • Use distributed transactions (.NET and T-SQL) across multiple Azure SQL Managed Instances for frictionless migration or modern application development.
